kurz: Mayonnaise is an [[emulsion|emulsion]]: one egg yolk can hold a whole bowl of oil in fine droplets, as long as the oil goes in slowly.
bild_im_kopf: Like lots of guests coming through a door one at a time instead of all at once.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir egg yolk, mustard, acid and salt together
Whisk in the oil drop by drop at first
schluesselmomente.warum: At the start there is little water to take up droplets.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Once it thickens, add oil in a thin stream
schluesselmomente.warum: The stable emulsion now takes up oil faster.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Too thick? A few drops of water
schluesselmomente.warum: Water gives the droplets room again.
